name: Dawn of Gray
source:
An essay on relationships... And their outcome.

Dawn of Gray is a single-player visual novel in a special style, where you take on the role of a young man who is discovering himself and the feelings he may be experiencing.

More of a narrative essay than a video game, this project is a proposal for the more or less difficult experiences that we can live.

The 3 stories told will introduce you to a different character each time, with his own story.

[From the [url=https://wistfulware.com/game/dawn-of-gray/]official website[/url]]
translation:
一篇关于关系……及其结果的文章。

《灰色黎明》是一款风格特殊的单人视觉小说，你将扮演一个年轻人的角色，他正在发现自己以及他可能正在经历的感受。

这个项目更像是一篇叙事文章，而不是一个视频游戏，它是对我们可以生活的或多或少困难的经历的建议。

讲述的3个故事每次都会向你介绍不同的角色，以及他自己的故事。

[摘自[url=https://wistfulware.com/game/dawn-of-gray/]官网[/url]]
